entry.content: Their draft is finished: it was built to end the game at fifteen minutes, and at twenty-three the parts do not fit. evidence.c04.s0097: It was built to end the game at fifteen minutes, and it is now twenty-three, and the parts don’t fit anymore.
evidence.c04.s0098: Renekton’s damage falls off a cliff past twenty — he was a threat when our turret was at twelve percent and he could stun Mags and delete her, and now he can’t frontline because he dies in one rotation the second he walks up.
evidence.c04.s0099: Sable’s full combo can’t kill through Nox’s shields; I watched it land on Mags at three health and do nothing, and it will do nothing every time, because a LeBlanc with no follow-up is a spectator with a hat.

evidence.c04.s0101: Pyke’s execute only works on somebody below the threshold, and the only person on our team who goes below the threshold is Mags, and Nox has been pulling her out of it all night on a half-second lantern.
evidence.c04.s0104: Not one of them can break a disciplined five-on-five, and not one of them can clear a super wave, and neither can we — but we don’t need to.
evidence.c04.s0105: We have three of theirs to clear already.
evidence.c04.s0106: None of which matters if they walk it into our base.

entry.speaker: char:bess
entry.content: Hit it, hit it, I've got four more seconds of this, hit it.

evidence.c04.s0033: That’s the part I want to remember later, if there is a later: Bess standing under their inhibitor turret with her shield up and her health bar sliding, taking shots that would kill Mags twice, saying, “Hit it, hit it, I’ve got — I’ve got four more seconds of this, hit it,” and the turret firing and firing, and Ornn not moving, because moving is how you lose a wave.
